title: Come join me! DM @caravel_cup_roma on Instagram with the code PietroCaravelCup!
originalTitle: Come join me! DM @caravel_cup_roma on Instagram with the code PietroCaravelCup! #chess #tournament
transcript: I have a confession to make. I am a tournament. Meaning that I have to sign up to a chess tournament every chance I get. And so that means that even if in a week I'm going to be playing in the Amsterdam Open, I have already signed up for another very big tournament in Rome called the Caraval Cup. And the best part is that I want you to join me. If you play chess, live in Italy, or want to visit Italy and you're looking for a tournament to play in, well, I got the answer for you. Between the 19th and the 23rd of November, there are going to be nine rounds of federated classical games, and I'll be there to throw some punches. If you're up for the challenge, use this code to get a 35 discount on the entry fee. All you need to do is send the code in the DMs of the Caraval Cup Instagram page. You know what they say after all. Fools will resign. Wise players will make a draw. But only a true genius will come to play nine round of classical games in Rome. See you there.
